summary: Subagent分割を'独立・並列可能・要約で返せる'作業に限定し、query複雑度でagent数を段階化(単純: 1 agent/3–10 tool call、比較: 2–4 subagent、複雑: >10)、各subagentに目的・出力形式・tool・境界を明示して重複と統合costを抑える。

evidence.summary: Anthropic multi-agent: 'Simple fact-finding requires just 1 agent with 3-10 tool calls, direct comparisons might need 2-4 subagents with 10-15 calls each, and complex research might use more than 10 subagents'; token使用が性能分散の80%を説明、multi-agentはchatの約15倍token; 'Without detailed task descriptions, agents duplicate work, leave gaps'; 共有contextや依存が多いdomainはmulti-agent不向き
main conversationを使う条件: 'frequent back-and-forth', 'Multiple phases share significant context', 'quick, targeted change', 'Latency matters'。subagentは冗長出力隔離・tool制限・自己完結作業向け。fresh contextで会話履歴を持たない

Fable 5はsubagentをより積極的に使うため、'provide explicit guidance about when delegation is appropriate'; 'Delegate independent subtasks to subagents and keep working while they run'; fresh-context verifier subagentは自己批評より有効
Agent teams: 'Keep teams small... token usage is roughly proportional to team size'; teammates plan modeで約7x token

dispatching-parallel-agents (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md (skills/dispatching-parallel-agents/SKILL.md) via raw.githubusercontent: fan-out requires that 'each problem can be understood without context from others' with 'no shared state between investigations' and independent failures; connected failures and shared-resource interference are stated do-not-use cases; and every subagent prompt must carry a specific scope ('one test file or subsystem'), a clear goal, constraints ('don't change other code'), the expected output, and self-contained context with concrete test names, error messages and file paths.

applies_when: 調査・レビューなど並列化可能な作業と、依存の強い実装作業が混在する
not_applicable_when: 全工程が単一contextの共有を要する小変更
applicability.model_conditions: model-agnostic; Fable 5では委譲傾向が強く境界指示の必要性が上がる(公式)

expected_effect.primary: 不要なsubagent起動と重複調査の削減、統合cost低下
metrics: task当たりsubagent数と複雑度区分の対応

risks: 並列化を抑えすぎて長い調査が遅くなる(公式は並列で最大90%短縮の事例)
cost: AGENTS.md/subagent定義に数行、担当割当のtemplate
known_failure_modes: 依存作業を分割してsubagentが互いの前提を知らずに衝突
出力形式未指定で親が統合に大量turnを使う
subagent数上限だけ置いて担当境界を書かない(local: 担当と成果物を先に割り当てる)
